headline: Global Education Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Global Education Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - OwnPrep Private Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company directly holding 9,999 equity shares representing…
detail: General Updates - Global Education Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - OwnPrep Private Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company directly holding 9,999 equity shares representing 99.99% of its paid-up equity share capital . Subsequent to the aforesaid approval, the acquisition was completed on August 11, 2026
